species.name: Crappie
why: Water 59°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 59°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

South wind at 12 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Largemouth bass

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 12 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
